(3) Move `import { HomePageWidgetBlueprint } from '@backstage/plugin-home-react/alpha';` (line 505, after the tests) up to the import block at the top of the file.
Keep screen + findBy* queries, no waitFor where findBy* works, no test IDs, and the Apache-2.0 2026 header.
